paite: Sepaihte TOUPA aw, na omnate deihhuai na tel e!
heading: Korah tapate phatna La. / Pathian Phatna, Pathian Intual Ngaihna
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!

paite: Ka hinna in TOUPA huangsung intualte angai mahmah a, ahi, abahpih hial a; ka lungtang leh ka sa Pathian hing kiang ah akikoukhia hi.
english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

paite: Ahi, kawlgit in inn amu a, lensiam in leng amah a ding in bu amu, anou koihna ding in sepaihte' TOUPA aw, ka Kumpipa leh ka Pathian, huai nangmah maitamte ngei ahi.
english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.

paite: Na inn a omte'n nuam asa ua; nang ahon phat gige ding uhi. Selah
english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

paite: Nangmah a hatna neimi in nuam asa hi; alungtang a Zion naihna lamliante om in.
english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

paite: Baka Phaizang atot un, tuikhuk omnate abawl ua, ahi, vuahtui ke masa in vualzawlna in akhuh hi.
english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

paite: Hatna a kipan in hat nawnsemna ah apai ua, Zion ah Pathian ma ah akimusak chiat uhi.
english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

paite: TOUPA aw, Sepaihte' Pathian, ka thumna hon ngaikhia inla; Jakobte Pathian aw, bil na doh in. Selah
english: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

paite: Pathian ka phaw pen uh aw, en in, na thaunilhpa mel en in.
english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

paite: Na huangsung intual a ni khat om tuh mun dang a ni sangkhat sang in ahoihzaw hi. Gitlouhna puaninte a om sang in i Pathian inn kongkhak ngaktu hih leng ka utzaw ahi.
english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

paite: TOUPA Pathian i ni leh phaw ahi, TOUPA'N hehpihna leh thupina ape ding a; diktak a omte lak ah thil hoih a-it kei ding hi.
english: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, nangmah muangmi in nuam asa hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
